# Clinical Process

This folder documents the time-sensitive workflows and operational metrics of acute surgical care in Denmark, spanning from patient arrival to critical medical and diagnostic interventions. It tracks how efficiently hospitals manage acute patients by monitoring specific clinical timing indicators, such as the national median durations for administering antibiotics and performing CT scans. The data is sourced from the Akut Kirurgi Databasen, providing a centralized view of systemic delays and logistical realities in acute care delivery.

## Pages

- [[clinical-process|Clinical Process]] — Tracks time-sensitive acute surgical workflows in Denmark, specifically the national median times from hospital arrival to antibiotic administration and CT scanning.
